name: Analyze Ad
description: Deep-dive analysis of a specific creative asset. Use when the user asks about a specific ad by name, ID, or URL — "analyze this ad", "why is this working?", "why is this not working?", "break down this creative", "[pastes ad name]", "look at this ad", "what's the angle in this ad?", "compare to account averages", or references a specific creative by name or identifier. Handles creative lookup, disambiguation when multiple matches exist, entity hierarchy mapping (creative → ads → adsets → campaigns), and metric-appropriate analysis. This is the most common interaction pattern — users often analyze multiple ads in sequence. Always use this skill, not creative-strategist, when the user references a specific creative.
